claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.passive_plus_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Scimitar of Speed combines always-on weapon bonuses with a repeatable turn-based attack rider. The current surface forces a magic item to be either passive or activation, so the unit cannot be represented as one honest record.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has `modify_roll_numeric` for attack-roll bonuses but no passive atom for adding a fixed bonus to weapon damage rolls.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_instance_weapon_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current weapon filter only distinguishes melee versus ranged. This item's bonuses apply to attacks and damage made with this specific weapon, not to all melee weapons.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_weapon_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can grant an extra action, but not a constrained bonus-action attack with a named weapon each turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns"
